title: Compute efficiency: unary keeps only 0% of the multipliers busy

body:
With NX8's 8-bit static formats, the tensor that loses most even in its best format is layernorm output in facebook/DiT-XL-2-256: 32.1 dB SQNR (signal-to-quantization-noise ratio; higher is better) in fp8_e2m5, measured on that tensor alone by the format search. Measured on 27 models with a format search (of 290 surveyed).

Model outputs keep a median 24.4 dB SQNR against full precision, the worst 6.6 dB (Qwen/Qwen3-0.6B). 15 of 21 models with a prediction metric (top-1, perplexity or agreement) lose some of it; the most: microsoft/table-transformer-structure-recognition (agreement 100% → 0%: the share of samples whose predicted class matches full precision's), PaddlePaddle/PP-DocLayoutV3_safetensors (agreement 100% → 0%: the share of samples whose predicted class matches full precision's) and facebook/DiT-XL-2-256 (token agreement 100% → 64%: the share of token positions whose predicted token matches full precision's).

The tensors that lose most in their best format (their own error): layernorm output in facebook/DiT-XL-2-256 (fp8_e2m5, 32.1 dB), linear bias in SamLowe/roberta-base-go_emotions (fp8_e2m5, 33.6 dB), linear bias in deepset/roberta-base-squad2 (fp8_e2m5, 33.6 dB), linear bias in facebook/bart-large-cnn (fp8_e2m5, 33.9 dB), add output in facebook/DiT-XL-2-256 (fp8_e2m5, 34.0 dB), embedding output in BAAI/bge-small-en-v1.5 (fp8_e2m5, 34.1 dB), linear output in deepset/roberta-base-squad2 (fp8_e3m4, 34.1 dB), layernorm bias in jonatasgrosman/wav2vec2-large-xlsr-53-japanese (fp8_e3m4, 34.2 dB), layernorm bias in BAAI/bge-reranker-v2-m3 (fp8_e2m5, 34.4 dB) and mul output in facebook/DiT-XL-2-256 (fp8_e2m5, 34.5 dB).

Separately, the error accumulated along the data path (every tensor before a node quantized too): div outputs end furthest from full precision, microsoft/table-transformer-structure-recognition keeping only -inf dB there. The outputs furthest from full precision in each model's best format set: div in microsoft/table-transformer-structure-recognition (fp8_e3m4, -inf dB), reciprocal in PekingU/rtdetr_r101vd_coco_o365 (fp8_e3m4, -inf dB), mul in PekingU/rtdetr_r101vd_coco_o365 (fp8_e3m4, -inf dB), div in PekingU/rtdetr_r101vd_coco_o365 (fp8_e3m4, -inf dB), log in PekingU/rtdetr_r101vd_coco_o365 (fp8_e3m4, -inf dB), reciprocal in PaddlePaddle/PP-DocLayoutV3_safetensors (fp8_e3m4, -inf dB), mul in PaddlePaddle/PP-DocLayoutV3_safetensors (fp8_e3m4, -inf dB), div in PaddlePaddle/PP-DocLayoutV3_safetensors (fp8_e3m4, -inf dB), log in PaddlePaddle/PP-DocLayoutV3_safetensors (fp8_e3m4, -inf dB) and amin in PaddlePaddle/PP-DocLayoutV3_safetensors (fp8_e3m4, -758.2 dB, with full precision's selection forced).

Formats chosen (E = exponent bits, M = mantissa bits, u = unsigned): fp8_e2m5 11977 (60%), fp8_e3m4 5519 (28%), fp8_e1m6 2356 (12%), fp8_e4m3 1 (under 0.01%); 0% of tensors use an unsigned format.

A wider format or a per-row choice would recover most where a tensor's own error in its format, times its data, is largest: silu output in stable-diffusion-v1-5/stable-diffusion-v1-5:vae (fp8_e2m5, 42.4 dB), conv2d weight in stable-diffusion-v1-5/stable-diffusion-v1-5:vae (fp8_e2m5, 42.7 dB) and conv2d bias in stable-diffusion-v1-5/stable-diffusion-v1-5:vae (fp8_e2m5, 43.2 dB).

body: Most costly first: (1) **Layout conversions** are the largest overhead — 50% (1218/2417) of tensors between kernels must be rearranged by the reading kernel, mostly for attention-head split/merge (linear→bmm/attention), spanning 844 operations and 124 G MACs. (2) **NX8 format accuracy loss**: model outputs keep a median 23.7 dB SQNR with a worst of 6.6 dB; 14 of 20 prediction-metric models degrade, two to 0% agreement, with layernorm output in DiT-XL-2-256 the worst single tensor (32.1 dB) and accumulated data-path error hitting -inf dB for reciprocal/mul/div/log in PP-DocLayoutV3 and RT-DETR. (3) **Missing instructions**: 7 capability gaps force workarounds for 121 operations in 14 models, the most widespread being run-time addressing (52 ops in 13 models); nearly all workarounds are still unproven (0 exact, accuracy and cycles largely unmeasured, 0 extra kernels so far). (4) **LUT-limited activations and resource limits**: 705 operations (7.49% of calls, mostly silu/gelu) run through a 256-entry lookup table with worst -inf dB SQNR; kernel launches reach 235 per pass, 26 outputs sit at the FP32 limit, and 2 runs produced non-finite outputs. (5) **Compute efficiency** is the starkest absolute number: MAC utilisation is 0% on unary and binary primitives and at best 15% for conv2d, so the multipliers are almost never busy; cycles for workarounds and conversions remain unmeasured.
